description.value: Osaka Teppanyaki is a Japanese teppanyaki restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver where chefs cook at your table with dazzling cutlery skills on an iron griddle. The menu features steak, fresh seafood, free-range chicken, and garden vegetables prepared in a lively, interactive dining experience. The restaurant welcomes birthday parties and groups, making it a convivial stop for cycling groups riding through the Kitsilano corridor.
